name: Public Agentic NFT Registry

discovery.purpose: List NFT collections and identify deployed contracts
discovery.rule: Only collections with status=deployed are candidates; verify current on-chain state before any transaction.

agentId.note: Do not assume Agent ID is required. Check each collection's metadata and contract behavior; registry entries currently describe the permissionless mint interface.

safety: Never submit a transaction based only on this metadata.
Verify chainId, contract address, bytecode, price, supply, allocation, and limits on-chain.
Do not request or transmit private keys or seed phrases.
